test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Constitution of India came into force in:
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1950.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949.**
 
• **It came into force on 26th January 1950.**
 
• This date was chosen so as to commemorate the idea of Purna Swaraj put forth by Nehru in **1928.**
 
• At the time of its adoption, the Constitution contained **395 Articles and 8 Schedules** and was about **145,000 words long.**
 
• It is the **longest national Constitution** to ever be adopted.
 
• Every Article in the Constitution was debated by the members of the Constituent Assembly.
 
• The members sat for **11 sessions and 167 days **to frame the Constitution, over a period of **2 years and 11 months.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India had gained independence from Britain on** 15th August 1947** through the passing of the **Indian Independence Act.**
 
• **On 28 August 1947**, the Drafting Committee was formed with **Dr. B R Ambedkar as its Chairman** to draft a permanent constitution for the country.
 
• A draft constitution, prepared by the Committee, was submitted to the Constituent Assembly in November of the same year.
 
• The Assembly had been formed in **1946 **for this purpose.
 
• The constitution was passed and adopted by the assembly on** 26 November 1949.**
